title: Reader messages show the original first, with a translation beneath
description:
As a reader, I want every message shown exactly as its author wrote it, in its own language, with a machine translation offered beneath when it is in another language, so nobody's words are replaced.

Design (Ryan's decision 12): original always first; a secondary 'automatic translation' line, expanded on demand, only when the message language differs from the page language and only for the site's public languages. Generated once when the message is exported (compute once on change), stored in S3 by message id, content hash and language. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450), revised 2026-11-12 with Ryan's decisions.

Feature: Original-first messages

Scenario: A Spanish message on an English page
  Given a reader posted a message in Spanish on an English Story's conversation
  When an English reader opens the conversation
  Then the Spanish message is shown first as written
  And an automatic English translation is available beneath it

Scenario: A message in the page's language
  Given an English message on an English page
  When it is shown
  Then no translation is offered
